manifest.name: @domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher
manifest.description: Model and reasoning-effort switcher: composer seat with an Off/Max effort slider over session.models / session.selectModel

bundle.text:
# Bundle layer contributed by @domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher.
# Applied by `dsh plugin add` into any profile that lists this bundle.
#
# Skin switcher: composer model + reasoning-effort seat over session.models /
# session.selectModel. Mirrors the model-selection RPC face through a custom
# skin dropdown with Off/Max effort slider.
- insert:
    - id: ui-skin-switcher
      name: '@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher'

readme.text:
dsh-ui-skin-switcher · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）模型与思考强度切换器

中文 | English

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web 端打造的 **Claude Desktop 同款风格切换器**：换模型、调思考强度，都不用离开输入框。
[是什么](#是什么) · [功能特性](#功能特性) · [视频预览](#视频预览) · [安装](#安装) · [使用方法](#使用方法) · [为什么没有思考强度？](#为什么接入模型之后没有思考强度) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [许可证](#许可证)

一枚悬在输入框旁的**模型与思考强度切换器**：点开下拉挑模型，拖动滑块调推理力度，选定即刻作用于当前会话。

模型按厂商分组排列，当前使用的那一个带勾选标记；强度档位跟随模型自己的能力，切走再切回，上次的选择还记得。

样式致敬 Claude Desktop 的切换器：滑动手感、圆角轨道、悬停高亮。

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 模型切换 | 点击模型入口将展开按厂商依次排列的模型列表，选定模型后立即生效，对应的思考强度也会同步变更。 |
| 思考强度滑块 | 思考强度滑块支持点击与拖动双操作方式，设有多个强度节点；不同模型适配的强度档位存在差异，调节后立即生效。 |
| 最高强度点阵动画 | 达到最高思考强度时，轨道内浮现从右向左扫过的点阵动画，且滑块伴随着发光 |
| 逐模型记忆 | 记住每个模型最后一次选择的思考强度，切走再切回，强度不丢 |
| 主题自适应 | 全部颜色绑定 DSH 主题变量，深浅主题、透明背景皮肤下都清晰可读 |

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e60e874-4d08-44b3-be00-5e5ab213187c
> 如页面内视频无法播放，请点击**下方链接**，在新标签页中直接观看，无需登录 GitHub。 **▶︎ [点击观看完整演示视频](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher@main/docs/dsh-ui-skin-switcher-demo.mp4)** —— 模型切换、思考强度滑块、最高档点阵动画的完整演示。

**Web 端**（`dsh web`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher
```

**桌面端**（官方渠道）——在桌面应用的插件安装处粘贴以下包名，即可安装或更新：

```sh
@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher
```

安装后：Web 端重启 `dsh web` 并刷新页面；桌面端重启桌面应用。从 DSH 源码运行 Web 安装命令时，在命令前加 `pnpm`。

当前适配目标为 **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1**，声明的兼容范围为 `>=0.1.5-alpha.1`。该范围基于 `0.1.5-alpha.1`、`0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.3`、`0.2.1-rc.5` 与 `0.2.2-rc.1` 的核心接口源码核对；其他构建仍需确认兼容性，未来版本也未全部实测。

1. **切模型**：点击输入框旁的按钮，在列表里选一个模型；列表按厂商分组，当前模型带勾选标记。
2. **调强度**：对提供了思考强度信息的模型，模型右侧会出现思考强度按钮，点击之后——拖动滑块或在轨道上点按即可切换档位。

readme.section: 为什么接入模型之后没有思考强度？
readme.text:
这是因为当前模型不支持或尚未配置思考强度（`reasoningEfforts`）。**DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 及更高版本**可在**设置 → 模型**中配置各模型的推理等级；旧版本需自行修改配置文件。为确保模型响应正确，请参照对应厂商的模型配置文档填写支持的档位和值，也可将文档或链接交给大模型协助配置。

> 生效方式：你修改的是 DSH 主目录（`~/.dsh`）下的 `settings.yaml`，**不是本插件的文件**；DSH 会监听该文件并**热加载，立即生效，无需重启**，有效配置会同步到模型列表和强度选项，下次启动依然有效。

为什么要依据厂商文档配置？是为了确保声明的准确——**声明准确 > 声明齐全**。不同厂商、不同模型支持的档位和值可能不同，填写错误可能导致请求失败或配置不生效，因此我们不代填统一档位。

为什么我的模型没有出现思考强度滑块？ 滑块只为提供了推理等级信息的模型显示，未支持或未配置时只显示模型切换按钮。**DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 及更高版本**可在**设置 → 模型**中配置各模型的推理等级；旧版本需自行修改配置文件。为确保模型响应正确，请参照对应厂商的模型配置文档填写支持的档位和值。
切换主题后切换器颜色不对？ 插件颜色全部绑定 DSH 主题变量（`--dsw-alias-*`），随深浅主题自动翻转。若你用了把背景设成透明的皮肤，浮层会自动启用毛玻璃（backdrop-filter）保住可读性。

@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher

中文 | English

A **Claude Desktop-style switcher** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web GUI: change the model or dial reasoning effort without ever leaving the composer.

A **model and reasoning-effort switcher** floating next to the input box: open the dropdown to pick a model, drag the slider to dial reasoning effort — your choice takes effect on the current session right away.

Models are grouped by vendor with a checkmark on the active one, effort levels follow whatever the model itself supports, and each model remembers the level you last picked.

The style pays homage to Claude Desktop's switcher — slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight.

| Feature | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Model switching | Clicking the model entry expands the model list ordered by vendor; the selection applies immediately and the matching reasoning effort updates together |
| Effort slider | Supports both click and drag, with multiple effort nodes; supported levels differ per model, and adjustments apply immediately |
| Max-effort dot matrix | Reaching max effort reveals a right-to-left dot-matrix sweep on the track, with the handle glowing |
| Per-model memory | Remembers the last effort per model, kept across switches |
| Theme adaptive | All colors bound to DSH theme tokens; readable in light/dark themes and transparent skins |

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e60e874-4d08-44b3-be00-5e5ab213187c
> If the inline video does not play, click the **link below** to watch in a new tab; no GitHub sign-in is required. **▶︎ [Watch the full demo video](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher@main/docs/dsh-ui-skin-switcher-demo.mp4)** — model switching, the effort slider, and the top-level dot-matrix animation.

**Web** (`dsh web`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher
```

**Desktop** (official channel) — paste the following package name into the desktop app's plugin installer to install or update:

```sh
@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher
```

After installing: on Web, restart `dsh web` and refresh the page; on Desktop, restart the app. When running DSH from source, prefix the Web installation command with `pnpm`.

The current adaptation target is **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1**, with a declared compatibility range of `>=0.1.5-alpha.1`. Core API contracts were checked against source for `0.1.5-alpha.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.5`, and `0.2.2-rc.1`; other builds still need confirmation, and future versions have not all been runtime-tested.

1. **Pick a model** — click the button and pick from the list; the list is grouped by vendor and the current model shows a checkmark.
2. **Dial effort** — for models providing reasoning-level information, an effort button appears to the right of the model; click it, then drag the slider or tap the track to switch levels.

readme.section: Why is there no reasoning-effort switcher after adding a model?
readme.text: The current model either does not support reasoning effort (`reasoningEfforts`) or has not been configured for it. **DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 and later** let you configure each model's reasoning levels in **Settings → Models**; earlier versions require editing the configuration file. To ensure correct model responses, use the supported levels and values from the model vendor's configuration documentation. You can also give that documentation or its link to an LLM for help configuring them.

readme.section: Why is there no reasoning-effort switcher after adding a model?
readme.text: > Taking effect: you edit `settings.yaml` under the DSH home (`~/.dsh`) — **not this plugin's files**; DSH watches that file and hot-reloads, so valid changes take effect **immediately with no restart**, update the model list and effort choices, and persist across restarts.

readme.section: Why is there no reasoning-effort switcher after adding a model?
readme.text: Why follow the vendor's documentation? To keep declarations accurate — **accuracy over coverage**. Supported levels and their values vary by vendor and model. Incorrect values may cause requests to fail or the configuration to have no effect, so we do not fill in a uniform preset.
